column1: # found-by.tsv — where a defect was found: the values of a `Found-by:` line in the
# message of a maintainer's queued `fix` (scripts/trailers-lint.sh, CONTRIBUTING.md
# §Pull requests). One row per value, <value><TAB><what it means>, in phase order: a
# defect found at a later phase escaped every earlier one. A value is added here, and
# only here; a test fails on a `Found-by:` value a script or a workflow writes that is
# not a row of this file.

column2: a reviewer or the coordinator, reading a change, found a defect already on main
a flaky or broken test met in any test run: a train gate, a queued change's pre-check, a session's own check-hosted run
a scheduled workflow run on main, not a push
the trial of a release candidate
someone using a release or main, the maintainer included
a session working on something else found it by reading or using the code
